court_cases.case: T.V. Bhaskaran Kartha vs Deputy Commissioner (Appeals)
court_cases.status: Decided (judgment reported; outcome not read in full)
court_cases.type: Tax/statutory appeal (Deputy Commissioner (Appeals) as respondent) — not a criminal or fraud matter

note: Coverage limited: DuckDuckGo search backend refused connections and Bing returned irrelevant AI-generated results, so sanctions, regulator and news checks could not be completed reliably — all such fields set to null rather than guessed. What was verified: Indian Kanoon lists exactly one case naming this proprietor — T.V. Bhaskaran Kartha, aged 50, 'Proprietor, DHRONI AYURVEDAS, Pulpra, Mudavoor P.O., Muvattupuzha, Ernakulam 686 669', Kerala High Court, 5 Sep 2014, petitioner, against Deputy Commissioner (Appeals); a tax/statutory appeal, not a criminal matter. Note the name in the case is 'T.V. Bhaskaran Kartha' and the trade name is 'Dhroni Ayurvedas' (ayurvedic products), which does not match the claimed legal name 'Bhaskaravilasam Bhaskarankartha Kishore' or the claimed construction/DIY industry — identity match is probable but not confirmed. No OFAC SDN/UN/EU/UK/BIS listing found in the sources reachable (OFAC search tool is a JS form and could not be queried via GET; this is NOT a clean sanctions clearance). No credit rating, no regulator action, no negative news and no evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS found — absence of evidence only, not confirmation of absence. Per project rules, the 2014 tax appeal is not a rejection ground and is recorded neutrally.
